Every year millions of students sit for the IIT JEE exam to get into their Dream Engineering Colleges, but the selection ratio in Tier 1 institutes is as low as 1%.
To full fill this one dream an aspirant goes through a number of challenges , enrolling in a dummy school, giving up hobbies, moving away from friends and following schedules that leave no room to breathe and facing a high pressure competitive environment, the student is subjected to all of this at a very young age!
The challenges with engineering education in India continue till college education too, students face
